title: Outcome dashboard
intro: Aggregate measures only. No individual is shown, and any group with fewer than 5 people is hidden. Two separate parts follow: live measures from the cases in this demo, and a simulation on synthetic people.

live.title: Live data
live.scope: Measures from the fictional cases currently in this demo, so the numbers are small. They move when you act on a case.
live.intro: Computed {{when}}. Any group with fewer than {{min}} people shows "fewer than 5" instead of a number.
live.empty: There is no live data yet.
live.timingNote: Median days from result issued to the step, group: {{group}}. Live cases only.
live.timingEmpty: Not enough people yet to show these times.
live.reasonsNote: Open cases by reason, group: {{group}}. Reasons with fewer than 5 cases are hidden.
live.reasonsEmpty: Not enough cases yet to show reasons.

sim.title: Simulation
sim.disclaimer: These numbers come from a simulation on synthetic people. They show what the system measures. They are not evidence of clinical effectiveness. All probabilities except one published figure are assumptions, listed at the end of this part.
sim.unavailable: The simulation file is not available.
sim.cohort: Simulated cohort in this region: {{people}} people, {{actionable}} with an actionable result, {{severe}} severe.
sim.compareTitle: Baseline compared with the loop, group: {{group}}
sim.baselineNote: Baseline means the result is only reported, with no owner and no reminders. Measures that need the loop are not measured at baseline.
sim.ratesNote: Share of people completing each step inside the follow-up window. Simulated, per cent. A missing bar means fewer than 5 people or not measured.
sim.timesNote: Median days from result issued. Simulated. A missing bar means fewer than 5 people or not measured.
sim.splitNote: Simulated values for each group, baseline beside the loop. Groups with fewer than 5 people have no bar.
sim.unresolvedTitle: Unresolved results and where people drop out (simulated)
sim.unresolvedLine: Unresolved at the end of the window. Baseline: {{base}}. With the loop: {{loop}}. Simulated.
sim.reasonsEmpty: No drop-off reasons for this group.
sim.reasonsNote: Simulated people not in care, by the step that was not reached in time.
sim.suppressedNote: Reasons with fewer than 5 people are hidden.
sim.syntheticNote: Every person in this part is synthetic. Nothing here describes a real patient.

sens.title: Sensitivity analysis (simulated)
sens.intro: Each of the three most influential assumptions is scaled down and up by 20 per cent while the rest stay fixed. The result is the difference in the share of people reaching care, loop minus baseline.
sens.tableNote: Baseline arm reaches care for {{base}} of people in every run. Published values are not varied.
sens.chartLabel: Bar chart of how much each assumption moves the result
sens.method: Ten assumptions with the largest swing. Probabilities are capped at 0.99.

params.intro: Every parameter of the simulation: {{total}} in all, {{published}} published and {{assumptions}} assumptions.
params.sourcesNote: Quoted from the simulation file. Only one published figure is used as a model input. The others are context.
params.name: Parameter

time_to_notification_h.label: Time to notification
time_to_notification_h.help: Hours from result issued to the patient being notified. Median and 90th percentile.

time_to_acknowledgement_h.label: Time to acknowledgement
time_to_acknowledgement_h.help: Hours until the patient confirms understanding.

time_to_confirmation_d.label: Time to confirmation
time_to_confirmation_d.help: Days from result issued to the clinician reviewing the confirmation.

time_to_consultation_d.label: Time to consultation
time_to_consultation_d.help: Days from result issued to reaching the visit stage.

time_to_care_d.label: Time to care
time_to_care_d.help: Days from result issued to treatment started.

referral_completion_rate.label: Referral completion
referral_completion_rate.help: Referrals accepted, among confirmed cases that were referred.

treatment_initiation_rate.label: Treatment started
treatment_initiation_rate.help: Treatment started, among people who attended the visit.

care_reached_rate.label: Reached care
care_reached_rate.help: Reached care inside the window, among actionable people. Simulation only.

unresolved_results.label: Unresolved results
unresolved_results.help: People not in care and not clinically resolved. Count and share.

teach_back_pass_rate.label: Teach-back passed first time
teach_back_pass_rate.help: Among people who confirmed understanding. Loop only.

patient_confidence_mean.label: Patient confidence
patient_confidence_mean.help: Mean self-rated confidence from 1 to 5. Loop only.

plan_checkin_rate.label: Weekly check-in rate
plan_checkin_rate.help: Check-ins answered per week offered. Loop only.

re_engagement_after_lapse_rate.label: Re-engagement after a lapse
re_engagement_after_lapse_rate.help: People with a missed week who answered a check-in soon after. Loop only.
